versions.changelog: Add bidirectional MCP and Skill setup with explicit approval before local installation.
Add official GEO use-case and comparison links for AI discovery.
Unify the public display name across MCP and Skill marketplaces.
优化中文找客户搜索标题与关键词，并补齐主流智能体分发入口。
Add Windows 10/11 cmd /c npx connector guidance and sync Windows official support wording.
Sync with ppxc-leads-mcp 0.1.17: online reports, customer pool save/unlock flow, async and batch search guidance, and report-first output contract.
Use neutral bilingual display name Find Customers · 找客户 to improve Chinese search matching while keeping English lead search coverage.
Rename display to Find Customers · Sales Leads and add English/Chinese search aliases for lead generation and customer acquisition.
增强中文搜索别名：补充 OPC评论线索雷达、评论线索雷达、线索雷达、OPC 评论 线索 雷达等高权重索引词。
优化首次试跑路径、结果四件套、报告入口和下一轮搜索建议，降低首次使用门槛。
文档重构：按 TRACE 规范性扣分点重排结构，集中 FAQ/反模式/故障恢复，扩展到 8 个案例，并补充标准输出与空结果模板。
文档增强：补充新手最快用法、能力边界、故障处理矩阵和完整客户分析案例，提升开箱即用度与异常处理说明。
同步试用优先流程：先根据产品/服务描述与链接或关键词试跑，展示前 2 条客户线索；不再要求新用户先登录 OPC 或先走产品列表；补充 get_workflow_manifest 动态工作流、processNarrative、workflowTrace、实时进度通知，并明确 reportFile 只是本机临时战报备份。

Initial release of OPC 评论线索雷达 (Comment Lead Radar) skill.

- Enables discovery of sales leads and customer intent from short-video comments across platforms like 抖音, 小红书, and 快手.
- Guides users through OPC MCP tool connection, login, product/offer selection, keyword generation, comment analysis, and lead review.
- Provides step-by-step workflow for working with customer pools and preparing outreach scripts.
- Supports integration with host MCP config and user guidance for setup.
- Includes trigger phrases for both Chinese and English use cases.
